title: CHICELLE
body_html:
Bright strawberry, delicate florals and warm vanilla shape CHICELLE, a playful yet elegant fragrance with a soft, distinctive signature.

Chicelle

Top Notes

Strawberry•Granny Smith Apple•Peony

Heart Notes

Sugary Notes•Rose•Praline•Jasmine

Base Notes

Iris•Vanilla•Amber•Musk

Key Notes

Strawberry

Peony

Jasmine

Vanilla

The composition

A refined floral heart

As the fragrance develops, rose and jasmine create a refined floral heart. Praline, sugary notes and vanilla then melt into amber and musk, leaving a smooth, indulgent trail that balances feminine softness with confident presence.

title: D'OLCEZZA
body_html:
Luminous red berries, creamy coconut and soft vanilla unfold through D’OLCEZZA, a refined gourmand inspired by intimate Italian sweetness.

D’olcezza

Top Notes

Red Berries•Pimento

Heart Notes

Coconut Milk•Jasmine•Olibanum

Base Notes

Cacao•Vanilla•Praline•Amber•Musk

Key Notes

Red Berries

Pimento

Coconut Milk

Cacao

Vanilla

The composition

Sweetness, beautifully balanced

D’olcezza is inspired by the Italian art of enjoying beauty without haste. Red berries and pimento introduce a vivid opening before coconut milk and jasmine create a luminous, creamy heart. Olibanum adds depth as cacao, vanilla and praline settle into warm amber and musk.

title: OCEAN THE RIVE
body_html:
Vibrant citrus, sea breeze and cashmere woods capture OCEAN THE RIVE’s coastal sophistication, clean, effortless and inspired by the deep blue.

Ocean The Rive

Top Notes

Bergamot•Mandarin•Grapefruit•Sea Breeze

Heart Notes

Armoise•Basil•Blue Chamomile

Base Notes

Cashmere Wood•Patchouli•Vanilla•Musk•Amber

Key Notes

Sea Breeze

Basil

Blue Chamomile

Armoise

Cashmere Wood

The composition

A breath of the open sea

Bergamot, mandarin and grapefruit open with invigorating brightness, carried by a clean sea-breeze accord. Armoise, basil and blue chamomile bring aromatic calm, while cashmere wood and patchouli blend with vanilla, musk and amber for a soft, enduring dry-down.

title: WOUD & MOOD ABSOLUTE
body_html:
Precious woods, warm resins and refined leather build WOUD & MOOD ABSOLUTE with smoky depth, powerful character and a magnetic signature.

Woud & Mood Absolute

Top Notes

Citrusy Notes•Herbal Notes

Heart Notes

Base Notes

Key Notes

Saffron

Patchouli

Leather

Oud

The composition

Dark woods, absolute presence

A vibrant citrus and herbal opening gives way to saffron and labdanum. Patchouli and guaiac wood form an earthy structure enriched by smoky leather, oud and nagarmotha. Musk and amber soften the finish without diminishing its bold, enduring character.

title: ZEN'GI
body_html:
Sparkling citrus, golden honey and warm woods give ZEN’GI its balance of energy and depth, with an elegant, unexpectedly refined signature.

The composition

Radiance with inner depth

Grapefruit and bergamot open with vivid freshness as wine and pink pepper introduce warmth and character. Olibanum, patchouli and vetiver deepen the composition before vanilla, cedarwood and amber reveal a rich, polished and lasting finish.

title: MANGONIFISCENT
body_html:
Juicy mango, elegant florals and creamy woods give MANGONIFISCENT its tropical radiance, balancing addictive brightness with refined depth.

Mangonifiscent

The composition

Mango in its most luxurious form

Ripe mango and bergamot create a juicy opening, complemented by aromatic geranium and honeyed sweetness. Rose and jasmine refine the heart, while sandalwood, patchouli and mossy notes add depth around a smooth base of vanilla, musk and amber.

title: MASHUMARO マシュマロ
body_html:
Soft marshmallow, creamy milk and cashmere woods wrap MASHUMARO in comforting sweetness, with delicate florals and a softly addictive trail.

Mashumaro マシュマロ

Heart Notes

Cashmere Wood

The composition

Softness with a smoky soul

Mashumaro explores the contrast between innocence and sensual warmth. Marshmallow, milk and incense create a comforting opening before muguet and rose add floral lightness. Cashmere wood, caramel, praline, vanilla and musk complete its creamy, softly seductive signature.

title: BEVERLY HILLS EXCLUSIVE
body_html:
Golden honey, smooth tobacco and creamy tonka define BEVERLY HILLS EXCLUSIVE, a polished signature of warmth, elegance and quiet confidence.

Tobacco

The composition

Polished, rich and sensual

Bergamot, clary sage and cardamom provide a fresh aromatic opening before rose and orris introduce refined softness. Honey and tobacco form the rich heart, balanced by tonka bean, ambergris and sandalwood for a deep, smooth and elegant dry-down.

title: CRUSH ON ME
body_html:
Rich caramel, earthy patchouli and bright citrus give CRUSH ON ME its bold, modern character, leaving an irresistible and addictive signature.

Crush On Me

Base Notes

Caramel

Patchouli

The composition

A magnetic gourmand contrast

Lime and ginger bring vivid freshness while saffron adds warmth and polish. Orris, magnolia and rose soften the heart before caramel meets earthy patchouli, woods, musk and amber, creating a captivating trail that feels rich without becoming heavy.

title: AKDENIZ

The brightness of the Mediterranean

Lemon and grapefruit illuminate a marine opening while apple and pineapple add crisp energy. Lavandin, thyme, myrtle and white florals form an aromatic heart before patchouli, cedarwood, sandalwood, leather, amber, musk and vanilla create a smooth finish.

title: SOSCENTIFIC

Grapefruit, cherry and pink pepper create a bright opening as osmanthus, orange blossom and jasmine add floral radiance. Plum, peach and strawberry form a generous fruit accord before cedarwood, amber, musk and vanilla create a smooth, lingering dry-down.

title: CHOCOLATE MAKES ME HAPPY

The composition

Decadence, bottled

Grapefruit and mandarin add subtle brightness before lavender, ginger and cinnamon bring aromatic spice. Dark chocolate and cacao take centre stage as labdanum and olibanum add resinous warmth, finished with coffee, caramel, woods, musk and amber.

Mandarin and lemon open with energy, complemented by pink pepper, coriander and cardamom. Rose and jasmine soften a warm aromatic heart of thyme, nutmeg and cinnamon before patchouli, vetiver, amber and musk leave a clean, polished trail.

title: KUTAY
body_html:

Kutay

Bergamot and lemon provide a brief flash of brightness before whiskey and davana reveal warm, boozy intensity. Agarwood, nagarmotha and sandalwood frame caramel, tobacco and vanilla, while amber leaves a dark, sweet and commanding trail.
